text:
Type: metal picture ledge shelf
Use: displaying frames, books and small decor on a wall; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, modern, industrial
Materials: powder-coated steel
Colors: matte black
Shape: long narrow L-shaped ledge with a raised front lip, visible screw holes, slim and very light, wall-mounted
Feel: clean, graphic, understated
Goes with: white or grey walls, black frames, light wood; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Metal Shelf, 24"W, Black
product.description: This space-saving shelf with hidden brackets gives you a place to show off photos and other treasured objects -- and the flexibility to change them quickly and easily at any time. The black painted iron brings a modern industrial edge to any room. 24" W x 2" H x 3.63" D Made of black painted iron Ready to hang, all hardware included
